structureNote: T7's Jukebox browses by game (T1-T6/TTT2). Western Heart browses by collection/era instead, because its soundtrack is WH's own: no Tekken audio files are claimed or shipped here. The tekken-data-only era lists the 5 data-only library slots for transparency and is never playable.

eras.name: WESTERN HEART ORIGINALS
eras.description: The shipped WH soundtrack before the Nosferatu and Cape Jones sets: Kevin MacLeod royalty-free tracks (CC-BY-4.0) plus the owner's own Eastern Mind (Tong-Nou) originals (owner-original).

eras.name: NOSFERATU
eras.description: The correct Nosferatu (1922) VHS synth score (Nosferatu1922VHS transfer, MoMA 1947 print), cut into 25 standalone tracks (PR #1030, merged 8579c6df). Track bytes are pending the Kaggle GPU cut job; until they land the engine falls back to its procedural loop.

eras.name: CAPE JONES
eras.description: Cape Jones set: 8 Loyalty Freak Music tracks, all CC0 1.0, vibe surf rock + spooky + witchy + batty + Halloween. Ghost Surf Rock is the MAIN track (user directive 2026-10-24 19:41 CDT, LOCKED): it leads every rotation cycle, the other 7 interchange around it. The Cape Jones arena does not exist yet; the era is selectable now and activates for stage id cape-jones-arena when it lands.
eras.bytesStatus: pending-file — MP3s not in repo yet; see game/data/audio-download-manifest.json

eras.name: TEKKEN DATA ONLY
eras.description: 5 Tekken 7 library slots (Mishima Dojo Round 1 + Final Round variant, New World Order, Blood Sweat and Fists, Kodama Starship). Data-only: file null, status pending-download. Listed so the Jukebox is honest about what exists; the engine NEVER plays these — resolveEraTrack returns null for this era and music.js excludes status pending-download from every pick.
